observed_history_definition: No previously observed functional difficulty within the cohort window
caveat: I0 means no prior observed difficulty, not lifetime absence of difficulty

observed_history_definition: First or continuing observed difficulty before any observed recovery
caveat: Baseline-prevalent D1 has unknown pre-entry duration

observed_history_definition: Observed independence after D1 or D2
caveat: Interview-observed recovery; exact transition time and intervening paths are unknown

observed_history_definition: Observed difficulty after an R1 state
caveat: Interview-observed relapse; exact transition time and intervening paths are unknown
Disappearance is never coded as death

observed_history_definition: Non-death loss, known-alive nonresponse, or unknown vital/observation status
caveat: Never treated as death; addressed through retention/IPCW sensitivity
